# Draft:Edward Speller

Edward Speller (born 9 July 2002) is a British YouTuber known for his online presence and growth across multiple YouTube channels. His content primarily focuses on reaction videos, gaming, and commentary.
Early Life
Edward Speller was born on 9 July 2002 in Harold Wood, London, United Kingdom. He has publicly shared that he was recently diagnosed with Autism and ADHD, which has contributed to the unique perspective he brings to his content.
YouTube Career
Speller has created several YouTube channels over the years, each contributing to his growing following. His first channel reached 7,000 subscribers before it was terminated. His second channel saw even greater success, amassing 32,000 subscribers before also being taken down.  As of 2024, Speller runs his current YouTube channel, TheReactionKing, which has gained 10,000 subscribers.  He has also managed to get over 4,000,000 views on his channel.
Personal Life
While much of Speller's personal life remains private, he has shared insights into how his diagnoses with Autism and ADHD as well as Anxiety and Depression have influenced his content creation and personal journey.
